thread:
Morgan: NexaExpress sent routing options for a 200x H100 top-up. Sea ETA 14-18w, air ETA 4-6w. Air premium ~+22%/unit. They propose CDG depot as a local RMA hold: 24h swap SLA for signed addendum + prepaid hold. PO and draft SLA in the drive.

Sanjay: 200 sounds large — can eu-west-1 accept an 80-unit air tranche without impacting customer-facing lanes?

Kevin: We can free capacity if we defer medium-priority batch jobs. Roughly 40-50% free in Dedicated pools early June, but staging/backhaul is the risk. Depot handoff windows must match our rack crew availability (6h contiguous window preferred).

Luca (NexaExpress): Recommend split shipment: 120 sea / 80 air. CDG depot terms: 14-day free buffer onsite, extended hold for prepaid fee (€15k/mo) and signed SLA; pre-assigned serial blocks speed intake. In-depot swap SLA 24h for warranty units when addendum signed. If not signed, DOA flow = courier replacement (5-10d). We can also file EID pre-clearance to speed customs.

Rachel: Quick finance note: full-air delta ~= +€550k. Example split (120/80) ~= +€260k + depot prepay (~€15k/mo). Two-month prepaid hold ~€30k. I'll draft a short memo for CFO.

Morgan: I like a hedged approach. Proposal: reserve an 8-unit air canary to validate the rack/install path, then bring the remaining 72 air units after canary validation. Sea bulk to AMS for customs/kitting. Ops: can you confirm canary lead time and transient quota needs? Also confirm CDG swap vs courier nuance for DOA.

Sanjay: I can carve out an 8-unit canary in ~7-12 days once AWB + serial CSV are provided and routing is approved. For the 72-unit air bulk, install crew needs a 48h planning window and a 6h contiguous dock-to-rack handoff. Sea bulk to AMS usually adds ~5 business days for customs + kitting.

Luca (NexaExpress): We'll DM proforma AWB + manifest CSV tonight. Serial pre-allocation is doable if addendum signed. Prepay invoice for CDG hold will be issued after you confirm hold duration.

Kevin: Heads-up on CDG depot kitting: EU plug adapters and shipping crates need rework if units arrive in certain pallets. Ops-bot, add power adapter packing note.

ops-bot: Checklist update: "attach importer license + HS 8471 doc + invoice copy for CDG clearance" and "confirm EU plug adapter set for depot kitting".

Morgan: Attaching PO snippet for context:

```
PO: PO-200451
qty: 200 H100
split-plan: 120 sea / 80 air (8-unit air canary + 72 air bulk)
ETA-air-canary: ~4-6w
ETA-air-bulk: ~4-6w staggered
ETA-sea-bulk: ~14-18w
RMA-depot: CDG, 30 kits hold (14d free, extendable with prepay), 24h swap SLA with addendum
notes: preassign serial blocks, proforma AWB + manifest required, importer license for CDG
```

Rachel: I'll circulate the CFO memo + simple cost vs outage risk calc. Luca, can you include prepaid-hold options for 30/60/90d in your quote?

Luca (NexaExpress): Yes — will include 30/60/90d prepay tiers and transit insurance options. Will upload quote + AWB tonight.

Sanjay: After AWB/serials, I'll publish the canary install runbook and request transient burst quota for Dedicated (48-72h). Need confirmation of install crew availability.

Morgan: Action items: 1) Luca send AWB/manifest + prepaid hold tiers (EOD) 2) Legal to review SLA addendum 3) Ops to schedule 8-node canary and request transient quota 4) Rachel to finalize CFO memo. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
